Perform comprehensive validation of a truss system.
Validate boundary conditions Checks: adequate constraints, no over-constraints, valid support types.
Validate member connectivity Checks: all members connect valid nodes, no self-loops,...
Validate geometric properties Checks: non-zero member lengths, no duplicate nodes,...
Validate kinematic stability Checks: no mechanisms, adequate constraints to prevent rigid body motion...
Validate load definitions Checks: loads applied to existing nodes, non-zero loads,...
Validate material properties Checks: positive Young's modulus, positive area, positive density.
Validate static determinacy Checks: 2n = m + r equation, proper constraint distribution.
Validate structural completeness Checks: minimum node count, minimum member count,...
Add a validation issue to the result.
